definitions.explanation: A warm, deep red color tinged with orange, named after the dye obtained from the roots of the madder plant ({茜|あかね}). Especially associated with the color of the sky at sunset.

examples.japanese: {茜色|あかねいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧。
⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{茜色|あかねいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}めた→染める：04253_someru⟧。
examples.english: The setting sun dyed the mountains madder red.

examples.japanese: {茜色|あかねいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked home while gazing at the sunset sky dyed in deep reddish-orange.

notes:
Composed of {茜|あかね} (madder plant, Rubia) and ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). The madder plant has been used since ancient times in Japan to produce a characteristic deep reddish-orange dye.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茜色|あかねいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: a madder-red sky
- {茜色|あかねいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed madder red
- {茜色|あかねいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to dye something madder red
- {茜色|あかねいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧: a madder-red sunset

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朱色|しゅいろ}→朱色：20098_shuiro⟧: vermilion — a brighter, more orange-red
- ⟦{緋色|ひいろ}→緋色：22034_hiiro⟧: scarlet — a vivid, pure red
- ⟦{紅色|べにいろ}→紅色：23780_beniiro⟧: crimson — a deeper, cooler red

CULTURAL NOTE:
This color is deeply associated with Japanese literature and poetry, where it evokes the beauty of sunset skies. It is one of Japan's traditional colors ({和色|わしょく}) and appears frequently in song lyrics, novel titles, and descriptions of natural scenery.
